verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū yāh hal·lū ‘aḇ·ḏê Yah·weh hal·lū ’eṯ- šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . Give praise O servants of the LORD praise - the name of the LORD

verses.original: מְבֹרָ֑ךְ יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ḇō·rāḵ yə·hî šêm Yah·weh mê·‘at·tāh wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore . . .

verses.original: מִמִּזְרַח־ עַד־ מְבוֹא֑וֹ שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל
verses.transliteration: mim·miz·raḥ- ‘aḏ- mə·ḇō·w·’ōw še·meš šêm Yah·weh mə·hul·lāl
verses.literal: From where the sun rises to where it sets . . . the name of the LORD [is] praised

verses.original: יְהוָ֑ה רָ֖ם עַל־ כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֥ם׀ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃ עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh rām ‘al- kāl- gō·w·yim kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw ‘al haš·šā·ma·yim
verses.literal: The LORD is exalted over all the nations His glory above the heavens
Who is like the LORD our God the One enthroned on high
He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth

verses.original: מְקִֽימִ֣י דָּ֑ל מֵעָפָ֣ר יָרִ֥ים אֶבְיֽוֹן׃ מֵֽ֝אַשְׁפֹּ֗ת
verses.literal: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump

verses.original: לְהוֹשִׁיבִ֥י עִם־ נְדִיבִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם נְדִיבֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: to seat them with nobles with the princes of His people

verses.original: מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י׀ עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַבַּ֗יִת שְׂמֵחָ֗ה אֵֽם־ הַבָּנִ֥ים הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: mō·wō·šî·ḇî ‘ă·qe·reṯ hab·ba·yiṯ śə·mê·ḥāh ’êm- hab·bā·nîm hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children Hallelujah . . .
